'''Sean McGarity''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 13th, 2–4, 4 (−96) at [[July 2000 Glenside tournament]] on 23 July 2000, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1027">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-rpg-outpost-glenside-pa-7-23-2000d1027/ rpg-outpost-glenside-pa-7-23-2000], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 23 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-23-rpg-outpost-glenside-pa-7-23-2000d1027/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
